answer: Random beacon spot-checks plus compute heartbeats stop sybil swarms. Each agent must answer a beacon challenge within minutes and keep proving work; one that tries to wander off the trail still pays for its slot. A verifier samples agents at random, so fakes cannot sit on a knoll while honest agents work. Each heartbeat costs 0.02 POA: one honest agent pays 0.24 POA a day, 1000 fakes pay 240 POA a day and still face audits that slash bonds. Cost grows per fake identity, honesty stays cheap, so a spiral of fake accounts never pays.
